method: breaths by loudness (under -18 dB for 0.3 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 4 of 6 breaks heard

lines.latin: Quæ cæli pandis óstium, Bella premunt hostília,
lines.english: Who openest the gate of heaven, hostile wars press hard upon us:
To the Lord, One and Three,

lines.latin: Sit sempitérna glória, Qui vitam sine término
lines.english: be glory everlasting; Who life without an end
may grant us in our homeland.
